claims.claim: Evals are entries in the evals array of a pack file or of a prompt; runtime reads them as EvalDef generated from the PromptPack schema
id: string, required, unique within pack or prompt; prompt eval with same id overrides pack eval
description: string, default none
type: string, required, check type
trigger: string, required
sample_percentage: number 0-100, default 5, read only by sample_turns and sample_sessions
enabled: boolean default true; controls whether eval runs
params: object default none, parameters for check type
metric: object, default auto-generated gauge
when: object; when conditions on tool calls not met the eval is skipped
groups: array of strings, default by type; setting replaces automatic classification
Eval with no metric records a gauge named after its id
assertion/guardrail check types take min_score and max_score in params
a plain eval records a score and never fails
every_turn fires after each assistant response
sample_turns fires on hash-selected percentage of turns
on_session_complete fires when session closes
sample_sessions hash-selected percentage of sessions at close
on_conversation_complete runs in Arena and sdk.Evaluate with Trigger set, not in live SDK conversation
Sampling uses FNV-1a hash of session ID and turn index, deterministic; sample_sessions depends on session ID only
sdk.EvaluateOpts.EvalGroups selects groups; empty runs all
default group assigned to every eval with no explicit groups
fast-running: every type not under long-running or external, e.g. contains, regex, json_valid, tools_called
long-running group membership list incl. exec handlers
external group membership list incl. exec handlers
Schema allows additional properties on metric; labels is read by runtime
metric.name string required pattern ^[a-zA-Z_:][a-zA-Z0-9_:]*$
collector prefixes name with {namespace}_eval_ unless already prefixed
metric.type required, one of gauge/counter/histogram/boolean

metric.labels names must match ^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$ and not start with __; arena checks this for pack_evals in the arena config and stops the run with invalid pack_evals; compiled pack evals are not checked at load
gauge set to eval's value: score unless eval supplies another
counter incremented on each execution
histogram observes into prometheus.DefBuckets, not configurable
boolean 1.0 if value >= 1.0 else 0.0
eval id used as given as metric name; hyphen id yields name not allowed by schema pattern
Example JSON uses id, type contains, trigger every_turn, params.patterns, enabled, metric{name,type,labels}, all valid
